speaker: richard_field
text: The leaf is shut. One lantern. I will take it as far as the corner of the lane, and then it comes back with me. I am not thy link-boy past the corner.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The corner is enough. The pages are in the same fold they came in. I am not leaving them on the settle.

speaker: jacqueline_field
text: The cups stay on the oak. I will wash them when you are in the lane and not before. I have already wished you gone. I am not doing it again.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then I will not answer it again. Home. The shelf, and the fold.
